stem.en: A student sees that her school canteen sells no fresh fruit, and she plans a fruit-cup stall to change this. Which task of an entrepreneur does this show?

explanation.en: She has noticed something missing, fresh fruit at the canteen, and decided to fix it. That is identifying a problem. She has not yet spent money, brought together the factors of production (things a business needs, such as materials, machines and workers) or sold anything.

hints.en: What has she done so far: noticed, spent, hired or sold?

text.en: Identifying a problem and deciding to solve it in a new way.
Bringing together the factors of production to make a product.
Taking a risk by putting her own money and time into it.
Adding to the welfare of society through a finished product.
